title: A new approach to detection of highly oxidized products from ethylbenzene oxidation using matrix assisted ionization in vacuum-mass spectrometry
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EA00043F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lisa M. Wingen, Elizabeth M. Wingen, Yiming Qin, Michelia Dam, James N. Smith, Barbara J. Finlayson-Pitts
A new approach for detecting highly oxygenated products is presented in which products are scavenged to the surface of matrix particles, providing new insight into oxidation products of ethylbenzene and its chemical pathways.
